newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 10.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the April 11 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Miners, angry about huge wage arrears, block the Trans-Siberian railway in the Kuzbass mining region.
- President Boris Yeltsin warns corrupt officials that hard times lie ahead for them.
- The appointment of Sergei Prikhodko as Yeltsin's foreign policy adviser is a victory for the reformist wing in the Russian leadership.

- Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko says certain top officials in the Russian leadership are in the service of the West and are trying to stall the process of Russian-Belarussian unification. Will Moscow react to this, asks the paper.
- The European Union will open its market for Russian steel imports at the end of 2001.
